environment_contract_findings: In the documented environment the code imports, torch loads and the shipped checkpoints are in place; execution stops at FileNotFoundError on preprocessed_data_program/test.tsv. This is missing required data, not a dependency or environment failure.

The documented source for that data, the get_data.sh URL https://tablefact.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/preprocessed_data_program.zip, returned HTTP 404 when checked on 2026-07-27. The repository ships preprocessed.json and vocab.json but not the .tsv splits the scorer reads.
This is a candidate A1 correction under the maintenance policy: the link was not re-checked at the 2026-07-13 audit date, so we cannot say whether it was already dead then or rotted afterwards.
